dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey Mira, have you heard the "gwenchana ding ding ding ding ding" bài hát? It's going viral all over social media.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Of course I know it. That Korean bài hát is playing all over Saigon. But I don't understand why people thích it so much.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Because it's fun and catchy! If you want, we could go to the new cafe in District 1, they often play that bài hát. Maybe you'll thích the atmosphere there.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I'm not easily convinced. But... alright, I'll go. Only because I want to understand why that bài hát is so viral.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Great! I knew you would thích it. That bài hát has something that makes people feel happy, just like when we played chess last week.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't be so confident. I haven't said I'll thích it yet. But... when do you think we should go?
